capabilities: Open a terminal split beside the active note, the vault root, or any right-clicked folder
Run your real login shell (zsh, bash, or fish) with PATH, profile, colors, and full-screen apps like vim
Name and color-code terminals per project
Configure font size, background, and startup behavior
Restore terminals with the workspace after a restart
extras: Distributed as a manual ZIP download, not through the community plugin store. Uses a small native helper (mt-pty, SHA-256 verified) run outside Obsidian's process. Explains security posture and access scope in the README, with further details in an external guide.
problem: Notes often live next to code and scripts, but running a build, git, or a shell tool there means switching to Terminal.app and navigating to the folder by hand.
summary: macOS-only terminal plugin that opens your real login shell in a split beside the active note, already cd-ed into the note's folder.
